sample_unit: online patient-facing texts on gender-affirming surgery

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-simplified texts versus eighth grade target
links.effect: Online texts averaged grade 12.66 ± 2.54. After LLM simplification, Gemini reached 8.39 ± 1.49, Claude 9.53 ± 1.85, ChatGPT 4 10.19 ± 1.83, so most outputs stayed above the eighth grade target.
links.quote: Google Gemini was most successful at simplifying texts (8.39 ± 1.49), followed by Anthropic Claude (9.53 ± 1.85) and ChatGPT 4 (10.19 ± 1.83).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the performance of eight LLMs in simplifying patient education materials for gender-affirming surgery to an 8th-grade reading level, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention practice.
